# Brine Prospect

> Brine Prospect makes a mail-in lithium test kit for produced water and oilfield brine, and publishes a free calculator and guide for valuing lithium leases and lithium mineral rights in the United States. Last updated October 7, 2026.

## Pages

- [Brine Prospect Oilfield Assessment Kit](https://brineprospect.com/): Mail-in sampling kit. An independent lab measures lithium, sodium, calcium, magnesium and potassium by ICP-OES. Price $495, lab analysis and return shipping included. Currently out of stock, with a waitlist.
- [How much are my lithium rights worth? Calculator](https://brineprospect.com/lithium-lease-calculator/): Free calculator for what lithium rights are worth: the royalty and present value of lithium mineral rights or a lithium lease, by net mineral acres or by produced water volume, with value per acre, worked examples and formulas.
- [Lithium mineral rights guide](https://brineprospect.com/lithium-mineral-rights/): Who owns lithium in brine and produced water in Arkansas and Texas, what leases pay, lithium concentrations by basin, and a pre-signing checklist.
- [Should I sell my lithium mineral rights?](https://brineprospect.com/sell-lithium-mineral-rights/): How to check an offer to buy lithium rights, what concentration an offer assumes, selling compared with leasing, and what to ask before selling.

## Key facts

- Arkansas lithium royalty: 2.5% of lithium revenue, paid quarterly, plus $65.05 per acre per year. Approved by the Arkansas Oil and Gas Commission on May 28, 2025, for the Reynolds Brine Unit (SWA Lithium: Standard Lithium and Equinor). The developer had proposed 1.82% and mineral owners asked for 12.5%.
- Royalty per acre: the Reynolds Brine Unit covers 20,854 acres and plans 22,500 tonnes of lithium carbonate a year, or 1.08 tonnes per unit acre. At 2.5% that is about $270 per net mineral acre per year at $10,000 a tonne, $405 at $15,000 and $540 at $20,000, before the brine fee. First production is targeted for 2028.
- Value of lithium rights per acre today: on the calculator's base case (East Texas Smackover, 2.5% royalty, $15,000 a tonne, 5-year wait, 20 years of payments, 12% discount rate, odds of a plant set by concentration), one net mineral acre is worth about $164 at 84 mg/L, $1,030 at 396 mg/L, $1,740 at 668 mg/L and $2,100 at 806 mg/L. These are screening estimates, not appraisals.
- Texas has no set lithium royalty. Leases are negotiated privately.
- Texas produced water: in Cactus Water Services v. COG Operating (Texas Supreme Court, No. 23-0676, June 27, 2025), produced water was held to belong to the mineral lessee (the operator) unless the lease expressly reserves it.
- Texas deep brine: no statute assigns lithium in brine to the mineral or surface estate. SB 1763 (2025), which would have assigned it to the mineral estate, did not pass.
- Lithium concentrations: Smackover project areas 400 to 670 mg/L; Marcellus medians 127 to 205 mg/L in Pennsylvania; Bakken median about 45 mg/L; public Permian Basin samples 1 to 30 mg/L. About 65 mg/L is cited as a lower limit for potentially economic production.
- Formula for produced water: tonnes of lithium per year = barrels per day x 158.987 liters x mg/L x 365 / 1,000,000,000. Lithium carbonate equivalent = lithium x 5.323.
- Lithium carbonate traded near $18,000 a tonne in early October 2026 and under $10,000 at the 2025 low.

## Notes

- Estimates on the site are screening estimates, not appraisals, offers or legal advice.
- Sources are listed at https://brineprospect.com/lithium-mineral-rights/#sources
